name: pl.domospacer/domospacer
title: Domospacer
description: Polish service turning building plans into a browser 3D walkthrough; free sun-hours estimate.

tools.name: get_service_overview
tools.description: Describes Domospacer, a paid online service in Poland that turns the plans of a building into a 3D walkthrough in the browser: what it does, who it is for, how an order works and what its limits are. Use when the user asks what Domospacer is, or about getting a 3D walkthrough of a house, apartment or commercial unit from its plans (Polish: spacer 3D, wirtualny spacer po domu, wizualizacja domu z projektu, wizualizacja mieszkania, wizualizacja lokalu, rzut, plany).

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Returns the current Domospacer price list, which depends on the floor area, and what the payment covers. Use when the user asks what it costs (Polish: cena, cennik, ile kosztuje, koszt spaceru 3D, ile kosztuje wizualizacja domu lub mieszkania).

tools.name: list_live_demos
tools.description: Lists the public demo walkthroughs of fictional properties: a house, an apartment and a commercial unit, with links that open in a browser. Use when the user wants to see an example (Polish: demo, przykład, dom pokazowy, mieszkanie pokazowe, lokal pokazowy).

tools.name: get_plan_requirements
tools.description: Returns the file types and size limits for uploading plans, and what to prepare for a house, an apartment or a commercial unit. Use when the user asks which files or documents are needed (Polish: jakie pliki, jakie plany, rzuty, przekroje, elewacje, PDF, JPG, wymagania).

tools.name: estimate_sun_hours
tools.description: Calculates sunrise, sunset, day length, noon sun elevation and direct-sun hours for a window facing north, east, south and west (and optionally a given azimuth) at a location, for the 21st of a month. This is a free-sky estimate that ignores buildings, trees and terrain. Use when the user asks how much sun a window, apartment, plot or facade gets, or about sunrise and sunset at a place (Polish: ile słońca, nasłonecznienie, godziny słońca, wschód i zachód słońca, strona świata, okna na południe).

month.description: Month from 1 to 12. The 21st of that month is used.

facade_azimuth_deg.description: Optional direction a window faces, in degrees clockwise from north (0 north, 90 east, 180 south, 270 west).

tools.name: start_order
tools.description: Returns the web address where a person can start a Domospacer order for a house, an apartment or a commercial unit, with the steps that follow. It creates nothing: no account, no order, no payment, and it accepts no personal data. Use when the user says they want to order (Polish: zamów, zamówienie, jak zacząć, rozpocznij projekt).

kind.description: What is being visualised: house (dom), apartment (mieszkanie) or commercial (lokal usługowy).
